subject: Physics
q: A uniform flag-shaped lamina has successive vertices (0, 0), (1, 0), (1, 2), (2, 2), (2, 3), and (0, 3), with all coordinates in metres. What are the coordinates of its centre of mass?
hint: Treat the lamina as a 1 m × 3 m rectangle plus a 1 m × 1 m rectangle.
solution: Split the lamina into a 1 m × 3 m rectangle of area 3 m² centred at (0.5, 1.5) and a 1 m × 1 m rectangle of area 1 m² centred at (1.5, 2.5). Thus x_cm = [3(0.5) + 1(1.5)]/4 = 0.75 m and y_cm = [3(1.5) + 1(2.5)]/4 = 1.75 m.
